languageDb.浊潮蔓延、珊礁枯败，昔日斑斓的珊瑚圣域正逐渐陷入死寂。\n完成六重修复步骤，澄净:
Toxic tides spread as coral reefs wither. The once-vibrant Coral Sanctuary is falling slowly into silence.
Complete the six restoration steps to cleanse the filth, regrow the coral, and bring life back to this silent sea.

A scarecrow reeking of decay. Curses the tiles around it.
Defeat cursed scarecrows to lift the curse from the tile.

In this place, every ending is a new beginning.

Mix and match different effects and attributes to shape a growth path that's entirely your own.
languageDb.通过修复与收集，提升时空稳定程度，收获大量资源。\n获取的资源越多，则会更加强大:
Gathering and conducting repairs will improve space-time stability, yielding even greater resources!
The more resources you possess, the stronger you will become!

Quickly, nip these schemes in the bud, time is running out!

languageDb.亲爱的朋友，\n过去的一年是坎坷的一年。我们有离别，有团聚，感谢你始终与我们肩并:
Dear friend,
Over the past year, there have been some bumps along the road, with both partings and reunions. Thank you for staying by our side through thick and thin.
Standing shoulder-to-shoulder beneath the dark and starry sky, we raised our blades to defeat the wickedness that sought to consume us.
We faced numerous challenges together on our journey in the new world, and as the situation seemed to grow ever more dire, you remained steadfast.
Behind every battle, your passion, wisdom, and courage were a precious spring of strength.
You have been a fearless pioneer and a trustworthy companion.
While the path was riddled with thorns and darkness sought to make us lose our way, with the support and encouragement of our companions, we always managed to welcome a new dawn.
Lucius tells us to remember the path we've taken, and that it's something we can always rely on when needed.
Vurk says to open your mind and set your sights high so that you never miss an opportunity.
Brutus reminds us that courage and honor belong only to those unwilling to yield under pressure.
Lyca's blessings bring serenity, while focus sets our eyes unwavering upon our goals.
Tasi's dreams show that companionship and friendship dispel the darkness and welcome in new light.
Estrilda never hesitates to lead the charge forward, with her staunch belief that only passion leads to true victory.
And finally, as Mishka says, may your heart embrace all of heaven and earth and remain ever pure.

In this new year, my friend, winter is fading and spring will soon arrive.
While the road ahead will be long, our steps will be more steady because we have each other.
Together, we will embark on a new journey and continue to pen our own legendary story.
So let us raise our cups and give thanks to our past while looking ahead to a future filled with hope!
Thank you for being there when your support was needed.
Thank you for being there through every dusk and every dawn.
May the new year be as bright as the rising sun, lighting your path forward.
And may our friendship shine like a shimmering star, always.
To you, to us, and to all the days we've shared together!
To every step on our journey into the future, let us never give up!
–– Your travel buddies

languageDb.呼！总算解决掉了这个该死的怪物，这群怪物可真是纠缠不休！: Whew.. That wasn't an easy fight. But there'll be more. These demons are relentless!
languageDb.呼~还好你们来得及时帮我解决了麻烦，作为报答我会加入你们的队伍。: Talk about good timing! You came just in time. As payback I will join you in arms!
languageDb.太好了，你们是帝国的军人吧！快帮帮我们！我们的农场遭到了豺狼人的洗劫！: Are you the knights of Esperia? We need your help, urgently! Our lands are being plundered by some strange looking creatures.
languageDb.让怪物在帝国的国土上横行，是军人的耻辱！你放心，我们一定会帮你夺回农场。: These foul beasts insult us by tresspassing on the king's land! We will not allow them to roam our lands. Leave it to us.
languageDb.我的爷爷过去也是一名帝国军人，只是他现在已经年迈体衰，无法再战斗了。: Thank you! I wish I could offer you more.. here.. take this.
languageDb.他让我把这套盔甲送给你，希望你能够穿上它，继续保卫这片土地。: It was once my grandfather's armor.. he's too old and frail to have any use for this now, but I hope you can find some use for it.
languageDb.这里为什么会有成群的骷髅出没？难道这些不死生物也成了恶魔爪牙吗？: What in the... Why do the dead walk the world again? Is this the demons' doing?
languageDb.现在还不能下定论，我们去前面看一看，说不定能找到什么线索。: I can't say for sure. Let's move forward and see if we can find some answers.
languageDb.你是什么人？为什么要帮助恶魔在这里作恶？: What are you? Why do you fight for those demon brutes?
languageDb.我并非恶魔的爪牙，是死去的亡魂将我吸引到此。哪里充斥着死亡，我就在哪里。: I fight for nobody. Wherever death is, I follow.
languageDb.我们在路上耽误了太多的时间，我们必须尽快赶路，前往帝都，否则等恶魔部署好城防，夺: This is taking longer than I expected. We need to make up for lost time and get to the city before the demons can fortify their position. But I fear we may be too late.
languageDb.人类，你们的都城已经沦为了我们的巢穴，现在你们又来这里送死，我相信你们的血肉一定: Ahh yes! More fresh meat. You'll make a tasty meal for us tonight. This city is starting to grow on me! I think we'll be staying for a while.
languageDb.帝都就在我们的前方了！命令全体士兵原地休整，天亮时分发起攻城战！: The city is just ahead. We'll camp here tonight and strike at first light.
languageDb.恶魔！从帝都中滚出去，这片土地不容你们玷污！: Begone, demon scum! You shall not sully this land.
languageDb.玷污？我们是在净化这片土地！不光是这片土地，很快整个大陆都将在我的熊熊烈焰之下获: Sully? I'd like to call it purging the land! Not only will your beloved city be purged, so will the rest of your rotten lands!
languageDb.还是先让我用火焰把你净化一遍吧，恶魔！: I hope you're feeling cold, because things are about to heat up around here!
languageDb.真是艰难的一战！好在众神庇佑，我们终于夺回了帝都！: It wasn't an easy fight, but we're still standing. The city is ours once more, as it should be.
languageDb.事情还没有结束，湮灭深渊的封印已经彻底破除，恶魔还会卷土重来: I'm afraid this is just the beginning. The seal to the barred gate has been destroyed and the demons are pouring through as we speak.
languageDb.单靠人类的力量无法与它们抗衡，我们需要盟友！: The Lightbearers won't be strong enough to take on the demon hordes alone. We require assistance.
languageDb.你说得没错！薄暮丛林的绿裔联盟也正在遭到恶魔的侵略，我们应该立刻前往薄暮丛林，帮: I agree. It would appear the forest folk are also under attack. We must head there immediately and aid them in their efforts against the demonic scourge. Perhaps they'll return us the favor.

About account deletion:
1. Ensure your device and internet connection are stable before deleting your account. You may contact customer support within 15 business days of deleting your account to cancel the process, so please take note of the time and proceed with caution when deleting your account.
2. Once the deletion process is complete, you will not be able to log in, use, or restore your account. All personal information stored within your account will be either deleted or anonymously stored, and cannot be retrieved.
3. Once the deletion process is complete, all in-game currency, items, and other paid services will also be removed. Please proceed with caution when deleting your account.
If you need to delete your account, you can click "Delete" in the lower right corner, and our customer support team will help you verify and delete it.

Ten thousand years ago, the God of the Hunt launched an unparalleled hunting campaign. He made Heaven and Earth the hunting grounds, and all life therein the prey. After his disappearance, the Gods sealed the hunting ground and never spoke another word about it.
